hazards.control: Pressure test before opening to the well; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.
Stay clear of the coil path, the gooseneck, and flowback iron under flow.

name: Positive-displacement motor
function: The downhole motor that converts pumped fluid into rotation of the mill.

tabs.overview: Rotor and stator in a helical pair; speed proportional to flow; torque proportional to pressure drop across the motor.
tabs.engineering: Sized to the coil flow rate.
tabs.safety: Stalls when weight is too high; pressure spike is the indicator.
tabs.evidence: Public coiled tubing pressure control guide (S24), API RP 16ST and API RP 5C7 scope (S23, S26), field practice (S9).
